title: Responsible AI (RAI) Games and Ensembles
reasoning: The paper focuses on an algorithmic framework (RAI Games) for optimizing fairness and robustness in machine learning models. It evaluates these methods on standard tabular (COMPAS) and image (CIFAR) datasets. While it uses 'Responsible AI' as a core concept and addresses algorithmic fairness (e.g., minimax group fairness), it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral philosophies, or ethical systems.
